blocks.en: # Frequently asked questions **English** · [简体中文](FAQ.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## Where do I start? Use [the docking entry](QUICKSTART.md#dock) to prepare inputs or run the public example. Use [the MD entry](QUICKSTART.md#existing-pose) for a reviewed pose or prebuilt system and [the analysis entry](QUICKSTART.md#existing-trajectory) for an existing trajectory or figure data. ## What failed first? Read the earliest failure in the earliest unfinished stage, then check tool version, input hashes, and output existence in that order. Run the corresponding `check_01.sh` through `check_12.sh`. See the [error index](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#triage). ## Why did Meeko fail on the upstream PDB? The public 1IEP input has a displaced atom record. Meeko 0.8.0 reported the following actual error.
blocks.zh: # 常见问题 [English](FAQ.md) · **简体中文** [仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) ## 从哪里开始？ 制备输入或复跑公开示例，请走[只做对接](QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#dock)。已有审核过的位姿或建系文件，走[只做 MD](QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#existing-pose)。已有轨迹或制图数据，走[分析或出图](QUICKSTART.zh-CN.md#existing-trajectory)。 ## 先查哪一步？ 找出第一个尚未完成的阶段，读最早的报错，再按工具版本、输入哈希、输出文件的顺序核对。运行对应的 `check_01.sh` 到 `check_12.sh`。见[报错索引](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#triage)。 ## Meeko 为什么拒绝上游 PDB？ 公开的 1IEP 输入有一条原子记录错位。Meeko 0.8.0 实际报错如下。

blocks.en:
The example restores the pinned receptor atom order by serial number while preserving coordinates. It saves the repaired PDB separately. A different PDB with interrupted chains, alternate conformations, or mixed models needs a separate review. [Input provenance](../examples/1iep/PROVENANCE.md)

## Why is the ligand charge +1?

The pinned prepared SDF encodes a protonated ligand. Open Babel round-trips the MOL2 to SDF before RDKit validates chemistry and coordinates. In development, reading this MOL2 directly with RDKit produced the actual error below. The round-trip validated the intended cation.
blocks.zh:
示例仅对固定 receptor（受体）按原子序号恢复记录顺序，保持坐标不变，另存修复后的 PDB。其他含断链、替代构象或多模型的文件须独立审核。[输入来源](../examples/1iep/PROVENANCE.md)

## 配体为什么是 +1 电荷？

固定的上游 SDF 已指定质子化配体。先用 Open Babel 将 MOL2 往返回 SDF，再用 RDKit 查化学图和坐标。开发时 RDKit 直接读这份 MOL2 的实际报错如下。往返检验确认了目标阳离子。

blocks.shared:
```text
Explicit valence for atom # 16 N, 4, is greater than permitted
```

blocks.en:
Use the verified input charge with ACPYPE. The GROMACS examples elsewhere use a neutral generic ligand only when declared.

## What about WSL2, quoting, and permissions?

Store Linux work directories and active trajectories in the WSL filesystem. The Windows-mounted filesystem adds cross-filesystem overhead and can have different permission semantics. Quote paths containing spaces in Bash or PowerShell. Use a short ASCII working path for legacy native Windows tooling when it fails to parse a path. Keep shell scripts and text configuration files in LF format, and use plain ASCII quotes for commands. The repository sets line endings for scripts. Use writable scratch rather than running as root inside a container or on a cluster. [Microsoft WSL file-system guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/filesystems)

## Can I ignore warnings or restart from a failed stage?

GROMACS preprocessing stops on warnings by default. Trace missing parameters, topology mismatch and invalid restraints before proceeding. The example creates a fresh run directory. For a validated production checkpoint, use the [checkpoint restart guide](SIMULATION.md#server-handoff). Keep the original inputs, topology, MDP, TPR, CPT, sampled trajectory, and logs. Scratch outputs can be removed after verifying the archived copies.

[Open a reproducible issue](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/issues/new/choose)
blocks.zh:
把核验后的电荷交给 ACPYPE。教程中的通用中性配体命令需根据实际体系调整。

## WSL2、引号和权限有哪些坑？

将 Linux 工作目录和活跃轨迹放在 WSL 文件系统。Windows 挂载盘会增加跨文件系统 I/O 开销，权限语义也可能不同。在 Bash 或 PowerShell 中给含空格的路径加引号。老版原生 Windows 工具解析路径失败时，先用短的 ASCII 路径隔离问题。Shell 脚本和文本配置用 LF、命令用普通 ASCII 引号；仓库已规定脚本行尾。容器和集群内用可写 scratch，并尽量以普通用户运行。[Microsoft WSL file-system guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/filesystems)

## 可以放过警告或从失败处继续吗？

GROMACS 预处理默认遇到警告便停止。先核对缺参、topology（拓扑）错配和无效限制。示例每次创建新目录；对于已验证的生产检查点，请使用[检查点续跑说明](SIMULATION.zh-CN.md#server-handoff)。归档原始输入、topology（拓扑）、MDP、TPR、CPT、抽样轨迹和日志，核验归档后再清理临时文件。

[提交可复现的问题](https://github.com/LuciferBioLab/docking-gromacs-tutorial/issues/new/choose)
